old: yoneḥ ud ārithāḥ: the printed token yonerudārithā is read as yoneḥ ud ārithāḥ; ārithāḥ is taken as a 2 sg. middle aorist of √ṛ with ud, 'you rose up'; the form is not certain. yaje taṃ: 'that' is taken as the source (yoni). juhure is a perfect with present sense 'are offered'. janmann: locative of janman.
new: yoneḥ ud ārithāḥ: the printed token yonerudārithā is read as yoneḥ ud ārithāḥ; ārithāḥ is taken as a 2 sg. middle aorist of √ṛ with ud, 'you rose up'; the form is not certain. yaje taṃ: 'that' is taken as the source (yoni). juhure is a perfect with present sense 'are offered'. janmann: locative of janman. tam is masculine accusative and could also be Agni himself ('I worship him'); the translation takes it as the source (yoni).
why: reviewer (minor): tam (m. acc.) can equally refer to Agni ("I worship you"); the draft fixes it to the source (yoni) without saying the alternative.
